title: What Sprint Planning Can Teach CS About Product Friction
excerpt: A simple 30-minute review that helps CS explain a customer problem clearly, lets Product make the call, and gives the customer an honest answer.
primary_goal: Help CS leaders explain product friction clearly, get an honest answer from Product, and set a credible expectation with the customer.
primary_cta: Download and run the Product Friction Review.
playbook_description: A five-part customer problem brief, 30-minute agenda, and follow-up sheet for getting a clear answer from Product.
